# S1.14 — Land telemetry, tracing & cost/latency instrumentation (§5h.1, R-2.9.1 C0/Stage 1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5h.1 (`R-2.9.1` — the C0/Stage-1 slice per
§5h.1 §9) · ADR-0042 D1–D6 · ADR-0043 D1–D7 · ADR-0044 D1–D6 · ADR-0026/0029 ·
ADR-0033/0034/0035 · ADR-0036 · ADR-0039 · ADR-0057 · ADR-0061
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/018_S1.14__telemetry.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.9.1**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.13` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live
stage:** offline-only

## Summary
Lands the observability backbone's Stage-1 slice as the new **persistent**
crate `crates/hh-telemetry` (deps `hh-wire`/`hh-identity`/`hh-provenance`/
`hh-ontology`/`hh-ledger`/`hh-budget` only — no `Text` leaf authored, no model
call on any path). The binding position holds by construction: **a trace is a
deterministic projection over the run ledger, never a second store**
(ADR-0042 D1/D2) — the crate owns no database; every output is a `View`
folded from the durable prefix, a payload appended through `Store::append`,
or a declaration.

- **Closed scope/measurement-point table** (`scope.rs`) — the 16-kind
  `ScopeKind` sum and the verbatim §2.5 `MEASUREMENT_POINTS` table (M1–M19 +
  M-ENV-1…3: open/close classes, duration source, measured fields, producer,
  §9 stage stamp). M1–M12 wired to existing ledger classes; points whose
  emitter classes land later are declared `pending` with their stage — Stage-2
  lands emitters, never renames (CC8).
- **Clocks** (`clocks.rs`) — `MeasuredAt` (adapter / external_gateway /
  interceptor / executor / runtime / participant), integer `*_ms` payload
  durations from monotonic clocks, `DEFAULT_CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS = 5`,
  `clock_skew_flag` when `|payload_ms − ts_span_ms| > tolerance`; `ts` orders
  nothing and malformed timestamps are never guessed.
- **`TokenVector`** (`tokens.rs`) — strict codec + invariants
  (`input_total = input_uncached + cache_read + cache_write`,
  `output_reasoning ≤ output_total`, `convention = "hh-inclusive/1"`,
  mandatory `normalizer_ref`); `normalize_usage` converges the four provider
  shapes (inclusive-cached, exclusive-cached, details-nested, flat);
  `cache_hit_rate_ppm` is `None` on 0/0 — never a fabricated zero.
- **`SinkPolicy` + L0–L3** (`sinks.rs`) — the closed `ContentClass` sum
  (`accounting`/`structural`/`content`/`diagnostic`); construction-time
  invariants: `content` ⇒ `requires_consent` (`MissingConsent`), `content` ∩
  `diagnostic` = ∅, coherent sampling shapes, metric-view sinks cannot sample
  below `all` (`ForbiddenSampling`); `version_id` via `idp/1`;
  `RecordKind::SinkPolicy` added to `hh-identity`.
- **Propagation** (`propagation.rs`) — the subprocess seam:
  `HH_TRACEPARENT`/`HH_TRACESTATE`/`HH_BAGGAGE`; ids derive via
  domain-separated `idp/1` hashing (`H(root_run_id)[0:16]` /
  `H(event_id)[0:8]` — OQ-115's ratified provisional derivation);
  `inbound_context` resolves `hh` members to `EventRef` links and refuses
  malformed context (`InvalidInboundContext` — never parented);
  `PropagationUnsupported` is a loss-report entry, never silent.
- **Pure views** (`views.rs`) — `trace_view` (one `Span` per scope-opening
  event; `model_attempt` coordinated as `<model_call_id>/a<attempt_no>` — a
  view-level coordinate, not a ledger field; `SpanStatus{ok, error{class},
  open, cancelled, rolled_back}`; `open_scopes` audit hook), `cost_view`
  (folds `hh-budget` `SpendRow`/`Money`/`ResourceVector` — `provenance_mix`
  map + `min` confidence, never averaged; `MixedCurrency` refuses, never
  converts), `metric_view` (`value | n/a{reason}` with `computed_from`
  EventRefs — insufficient observability renders typed `n/a`, never 0),
  `sink_deliveries`.
- **Metric catalogue** (`catalogue.rs`) — the §8 process-metric names as
  `ProcessMetric{name, requires_observability, applies_to_classes,
  computed_from_classes, unit}` rows; `registry_check` resolves every row's
  classes against `CLASS_TABLE`'s `min_observability` — **closes DF-S1.5-2**.
- **Export lowering** (`export.rs`) — `export_view`/`export_events` apply
  content classes (non-`content` sinks get `{ref, len, digest}` projections
  only), per-field `max_field_bytes` truncation and deterministic sampling —
  every loss recorded in `TelemetryLossReport`; `deliver` is the only
  exporter append, `measurement.export.delivered` via `Store::append`.
- **Additive edits** — `hh-ledger`: `measurement.export.delivered`
  (audit-grade, provenance-mandatory) + `measurement.metric.emitted`
  (provenance-mandatory) class rows; `hh-identity`: `RecordKind::SinkPolicy`.

## Decisions
ADR-0245 — crate shape; projection-only views; the `<model_call_id>/a<n>`
attempt coordinate; the subprocess propagation seam + provisional id
derivation; loss-as-data; the two class rows' table placement.
ADR-0246 — the declarative closed `MEASUREMENT_POINTS` table; payload
durations vs `ts` (skew detection, never inferred durations); strict
`TokenVector` invariants + four-shape normalization; `hh-budget` type reuse;
the `registry_check`/`n/a` rule.
ADR-0247 — L0–L3 closed sum; `SinkPolicy` construction-time invariants;
export-only sampling; per-field truncation loss; `deliver` as the sole
accountable append; declared-pending catalogue rows.
